# VVX Recording — Participant Information & Consent

> ⚠️ Template. Have this reviewed by your institution's ethics board and, where applicable, legal
> counsel **before recording**. See [`../16-privacy-compliance.md`](../16-privacy-compliance.md) §8.

## Part 1 — Information for participants

### What is this study?

We are building a system that separates the voices of people talking at the same time, so that a
listener can hear one person at a time from a recording where several people spoke over each other.

To train and test it, we need recordings of real conversations with overlapping speech.

### What will you be asked to do?

Take part in a recorded conversation of **3–10 minutes** with 1–3 other people, in a room, on camera.
Some segments will be natural conversation; in others you'll be asked to deliberately talk at the
same time as another participant.

You will wear a small clip-on or headset microphone in addition to the room camera. This gives us a
reference recording of your voice alone, which is what makes the data scientifically useful.

### What will be recorded?

- Video of you speaking
- Audio from your individual microphone
- Audio from the room camera microphone

### What topics?

Everyday, non-sensitive topics — we'll give you prompts. **Please do not discuss anything personal,
confidential, medical, financial or otherwise sensitive.** If you accidentally do, tell us and we'll
delete that recording.

### How will it be used?

- To train and evaluate speech separation models
- To measure how well the system works

Your recordings are stored encrypted, accessible only to the project team.

### Will it be published or shown publicly?

**Only if you separately agree** (Part 2, item 4). Most recordings are used for training and
measurement only and are never shown to anyone outside the project.

### How long will it be kept?

Until the project ends, or **[N] years**, whichever is sooner. Then deleted.

### Can you change your mind?

Yes — at any time, without giving a reason and without any consequence. Contact
**[contact]** and your recordings will be deleted. Where your data has already been used to train a
model, we will exclude it from the next training cycle.

Note: once a model has been trained, we cannot remove the influence of your data from that already-
trained model. We can and will exclude it going forward.

### Risks

Low. The main risk is that your voice and face are recorded. We mitigate this with encryption,
restricted access, limited retention, and by not publishing anything without separate consent.
